blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A national coalition on Friday called on Congress to further increase the proposed government budget for education in 2027 as both chambers prepare for bicam. E-Net Philippines made the pronouncement after the Nov. 24 Senate plenary deliberations where senators called for increased funding for education. READ: Senate approves ₱915.4B DepEd budget for 2027 According to the coalition, while it welcomes the Senate’s P915.5-billion budget for Department of Education (DepEd), which represents an additional P6.3 billion from the House-approved General Appropriations Bill, significant funding gaps still remain.
